name: premi
description: Premi - Better than Prezi: presentazioni zoomabili, app desktop
author: LateButSafe

scripts.postinstall: npm ci --prefix client && npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix desktop
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix desktop
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build && npm run dist --prefix desktop
scripts.pack:desktop: npm run build && npm run pack --prefix desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
